info.title: INSYS Core API
info.description: Multi-tenant insurance administration platform. The tenant comes from the bearer token's tenant_id claim.

get.summary: List dead-lettered messages
get.description: Messages whose delivery failed after all retries (INT-006), oldest first, with cursor pagination.

get.summary: Get a dead-lettered message
get.description: Returns the dead letter with its original event envelope. The ETag is required to replay or discard it.

post.summary: Replay a dead-lettered message
post.description: Delivers the original event to its consumers again. Consumers skip events they already processed (INT-005, INT-006).

post.summary: Discard a dead-lettered message
post.description: Closes the dead letter without delivering it (INT-006).

post.summary: Register an individual or an organisation
post.description: Give exactly one of individual and organisation; the kind never changes (PTY-001).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a party with its addresses, contact points, identifiers (without numbers), roles and relationships

post.summary: Add an address; it ends the current address of the same type
Add a contact point
Add an identity document number, unique per type and country in the tenant
post.description: The number is checked against the document type's format, stored encrypted with a keyed hash, and never returned.

post.summary: Record that an identifier was verified
Record a relationship from this party to another
Assign a role in a context; a party holds many roles (PTY-002)
Record an individual's death
Anonymise a deceased or dormant party whose retention has ended

get.summary: The party's current consent per purpose

post.summary: Record a consent; the ledger is append-only (PTY-005)
Record a withdrawal of consent
Merge a duplicate party into its survivor
post.description: The merged party becomes read-only and points to the survivor; the merge is kept in an auditable history (PTY-004).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

post.summary: Register a product: version 1, in Draft
post.description: The code is unique in the tenant and never reused; the family must be in the product taxonomy for the domain.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

post.summary: Create the next version of a product as a draft copy of its latest version
post.description: A change to a published product is always a new version (PRD-003). Only one version of a product is in progress at a time.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List a product's versions, newest first
Get a product version

put.summary: Edit a draft or validated version (a validated version returns to draft)
put.description: Submitted, approved and published versions are immutable (PRD-002).

post.summary: Validate a draft: coverages in the library and of the product's domain, benefit dependencies, effective date (PRD-004, PRD-009)
Run the rating test case library against a validated version (PRD-005)
post.description: Each case is rated as a dry run as at the version's effective date and compared with its expected premium and tolerance.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List a version's simulation runs, newest first

post.summary: Submit a validated version for publication approval
post.description: Needs a passed simulation of this configuration unless the tenant's approval settings say otherwise. Workflow then asks a checker other than the submitter, with PRODUCT_PUBLICATION authority (PRD-006); approval publishes the version, rejection returns it to draft.

post.summary: Withdraw an effective version from a date
Retire an effective version
Calculate a premium and record it with its breakdown
post.description: Uses the rating configuration in force on the rating date (today by default). The record keeps the inputs, the product version and the rating version, so recalculating as at the same date gives the same premium (PRD-008, LIF-002).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List a subject's calculations, newest first

post.summary: Rate without recording anything

get.summary: Get a recorded calculation with its breakdown

post.summary: Evaluate a rule set and record the decision
post.description: The most severe outcome among the rules that fire is the decision. A rule that cannot be evaluated, for example because an input it reads is missing, fails the evaluation and nothing is recorded.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List a subject's rule decisions, newest first
Get a recorded rule decision with its inputs
List approvals
Get an approval

post.summary: Approve (not by the maker, within the checker's authority)
post.description: The checker needs a role with authority for the approval type and, where there is an amount, a limit at least that amount (WFL-004).

post.summary: Reject, with a reason
Start a process from the workflow definition in force

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List process instances
Get a process instance with its tasks and case notes

post.summary: Suspend a process
Resume a process
Cancel a process
Add a case note
Assign or reassign a task; without an assignee the caller takes it
Complete a task and move the process along a defined transition
post.description: The transition guard is evaluated on the variables, then the owning module's validation (by DomainValidation code) runs; either can refuse.

post.summary: Escalate a task to the next escalation level

get.summary: List open tasks by queue or assignee, earliest due first

post.summary: Generate a document from the template version in force
post.description: Records the template version and product version it was generated from (DOC-002). Every merge field of the template must be supplied.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

post.summary: Store an uploaded document in tenant-scoped storage (DOC-001)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List the documents of a business reference
Get a document's record (not its content)
Read a document's content
get.description: Reading a confidential, personal or highly sensitive document needs a purpose and is recorded (DOC-003); a highly sensitive one also needs one of its category's allowed roles (DOC-004).

post.summary: Deliver a document by a configured channel; every attempt is recorded

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

post.summary: Place a legal hold; the document cannot be disposed of while it holds
Release a legal hold
Dispose of a document after its retention date, when no legal hold applies
Open a billing account for a payer

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a billing account with its schedules, instalments and arrears

post.summary: Create a policy's premium schedule (BIL-001)
post.description: Normally created from the domains' policy issued events; this endpoint is for authorised premium transactions.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

put.summary: Amend a schedule's instalment amount from a date; instalments already invoiced are not changed

post.summary: Issue invoices for instalments due by a date (the billing job does this daily)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List an account's invoices and credit notes

post.summary: Mark overdue invoices and detect arrears by the ageing buckets (the billing job does this daily)
Close an account with nothing outstanding
Request a refund; a second person approves it in Workflow before any payment (SRS-002)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get an invoice or credit note

post.summary: Correct an issued invoice with a credit note; the invoice itself never changes (BIL-004)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a refund request

post.summary: Start a payment; its Idempotency-Key is also the payment's own key, so it never moves money twice (PAY-001)
post.description: An inbound payment is sent to its provider at once; an outbound one waits for a payout batch.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a payment with its status history (PAY-002) and allocations

post.summary: Decide an unknown outcome from the evidence (PAY-005)
Reverse a succeeded payment and its allocations
Allocate what is left of a received payment to its invoices (BIL-003); done automatically when it is received
A provider reports a payment's status, signed in the X-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the body)
post.description: Every callback is recorded. An invalid signature changes nothing; a status with no mapping makes the payment Unknown (PAY-005).

post.summary: Batch the payouts waiting for a purpose and currency; a second person approves the batch in Workflow (SRS-002)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a payout batch

post.summary: Release an approved batch: each payment is sent to its provider
Import bank statement lines and match them to payments (PAY-003); unmatched lines become reconciliation exceptions

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Unmatched and ambiguous items waiting for a person (PAY-005)

post.summary: Take an exception to investigate
Resolve an exception you are investigating; an unknown payment is resolved first
Register a domain claim and allocate its claim number; a repeat returns the same number (CLM-005)

get.summary: Get a claim's registration, evidence and fraud indicator hits

post.summary: Request evidence of a type
Record evidence received, as a stored document
Record a communication on a claim
Evaluate the fraud indicators in force against the claim's facts

get.summary: Get a claim's financial movements and outstanding reserves (CLM-004)

post.summary: Set or change a reserve, or record a recovery; a reserve never goes below zero
Draft a claim payment within the approved amount; a repeat reference returns the same instruction (PAY-001)

get.summary: Get a claim payment instruction

post.summary: Submit for a second person's approval in Workflow (SRS-002)
Release an approved instruction to Payments, within the outstanding reserve
Release a failed instruction again to corrected payee details, as a new payment
Register a risk object; its attributes conform to its type's schema (GEN-005)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a risk object

put.summary: Update a risk object's attributes, against the schema version in force

post.summary: Revalue a risk object, with a valuation basis
Mark a risk object no longer insured
Create a quote, or (fromQuoteId) the next version of one
post.description: Rate it through Rating (POST /api/v1/rating/calculations with subjectType GENERAL_QUOTE and the quote's id); the recorded calculation is attached to the quote (PRD-008).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a quote version with its risks and referrals

post.summary: Issue a rated quote, valid for the product's validity period
Accept an issued quote within its validity period (GEN-001)
Reject an issued quote
Refer a rated quote to an underwriter
An underwriter's decision on a referred quote
Submit a proposal, with declarations, on an accepted quote version

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a proposal

post.summary: Accept a proposal
Issue a policy from an accepted quote version
post.description: Billing opens the account (if new) and the premium schedule; Documents generates the schedule and certificate.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a policy with its risks, coverages and cancellations

post.summary: Renew a policy whose product does not re-rate at renewal (GEN-004)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

post.summary: Cancel a policy; the refund follows the reason's refund rule (GEN-004)
Reinstate a cancelled policy where permitted
Draft an endorsement effective within the policy period (GEN-003)
post.description: Rate it through Rating (subjectType GENERAL_ENDORSEMENT) with the endorsed policy's inputs; the premium is the new annual premium.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get an endorsement

post.summary: Submit a rated endorsement for a second person's approval in Workflow (SRS-002)
Notify a loss (first notification)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a claim

post.summary: Register a claim: the cover is validated (GEN-006) and a claim number allocated (CLM-005)
Add a party to a claim
Appoint an assessor on an approved panel (GEN-007)
Approve a settlement: excess and limits are applied (GEN-008); a second person approves it in Workflow (SRS-002)
Decline a claim, with the decision's rationale (CLM-003)
Close a claim
Reopen a claim

get.summary: List a claim's loss assessments
Get a loss assessment

post.summary: Start a loss assessment
Accept a loss assessment
RequestFurtherWork a loss assessment
Record a panel repairer's estimate
Submit the assessment report; the coverage's excess is applied (GEN-008)
Open a salvage or third-party recovery (GEN-007)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a recovery

post.summary: SendDemand on a recovery
WriteOff on a recovery
Close on a recovery
Add a salvage item
Record a salvage item's disposal and proceeds
Record money recovered; it becomes a claim financial movement (CLM-004)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: Get a journal with its subledger entries and the posting rule versions used
List the journals of a business record (FIN-001)

post.summary: Reverse a journal: a new journal with debits and credits swapped (FIN-003)
post.description: The original journal is never changed (FIN-002). The reversal is posted on its own accounting date, which must be in an open period.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List accounting periods and their states

post.summary: Open a period defined in the accounting calendar
Soft-close a period: it accepts no more postings
Close a soft-closed period for good
Ask to reopen a soft-closed period; a second person approves it in Workflow

get.summary: Debits, credits and balance per account and currency for a period
Business events that could not be posted (FIN-007)

post.summary: Post a failed business event again, optionally on another accounting date

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

post.summary: Provision a user
post.description: The user is Invited until the first request with a token for the external subject.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List users
Get a user with its role assignments

post.summary: Assign a role
post.description: Refused for roles with no version in force, MFA-required roles without MFA (IAM-003) and segregation-of-duties conflicts (SRS-002).

post.summary: Revoke a role
post.description: Takes effect on the user's next request (IAM-005).

post.summary: Lock a user
Unlock a user
Disable a user and revoke their sessions (IAM-005)
Request time-limited privileged access
post.description: A purpose is recorded and the window is limited; someone other than the requester approves it (TEN-007).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List privileged access requests and grants
Get a privileged access request or grant

post.summary: Approve privileged access (not by the requester)
Reject privileged access, with a reason
Start an access review
post.description: Takes a snapshot of the role assignments in scope (AllUsers or Privileged) as review items.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

get.summary: List access reviews
Get an access review with its items

post.summary: Confirm a reviewed access
Revoke a reviewed access
post.description: The role ends when the review completes (IAM-005).

post.summary: Complete an access review
post.description: Every item must be confirmed or revoked first. Revoked roles end at once (IAM-005).

get.summary: List audit events
get.description: The tenant's audit trail of sensitive operations and denied requests, newest first (IAM-006, TEN-005).

bearer.description: OIDC access token carrying sub and tenant_id. Permissions come from IAM role assignments.
